dedupe_resolutions.notes: The Pentagon research chief's asserted continuing Anthropic supply-chain-risk designation is a legal and implementation development in the existing blacklist record, not a second designation count; the public statement did not identify which authority remains operative.
Lutnick's correction of his false statement about U.S. deaths concerns the casualty record and official-account reliability within the existing Iran/Hormuz war event.

The shared EO 14420 token is intentionally preserved in the grid record's timestamped correction note and source description. The official Federal Register assigns EO 14421 to the August 26 grid order and EO 14420 to the August 10 vaccine order; the records concern distinct events and subjects.

The records share a same-day White House fact sheet because it reports both manufacturer pricing arrangements and Medicare Bridge uptake. One is a set of announced company agreements; the other is an administration-reported program measurement.

rejected_candidates.title: USPS mail-ballot portal hearing

rejected_candidates.title: United States Space Academy executive order publication
rejected_candidates.reason: Federal Register publication duplicated the already-recorded executive order and produced no new funding, site, accreditation, opening date or first class.

rejected_candidates.title: Routine and narrow regulatory notices
rejected_candidates.reason: Technical classifications, information collections and internal personnel or emergency-use notices did not clear the archive's national materiality threshold or duplicate existing lifecycle records.

rejected_candidates.title: Meetings, campaign rhetoric and foreign-policy commentary
rejected_candidates.reason: Canada rhetoric, praise for Syrian shipping plans, meetings and other statements did not establish a signed instrument, implemented action, appropriation, court ruling or measured outcome.

rejected_candidates.title: Anonymous-source and prospective claims
rejected_candidates.reason: Consequential claims resting mainly on unnamed sources lacked sufficient independent confirmation, while prospective statements lacked an issued instrument or completed action.

rejected_candidates.title: Legacy same-date heading candidates
rejected_candidates.reason: The three generated pairs were inspected and concern distinct events sharing a date and missing imported headings, not duplicate text. They remain visible in the quality queue because a responsible remediation requires direct record-specific source review and complete reasoning-layer reconstruction, not a same-date inference.

rejected_candidates.title: External archive discovery leads
